_note: 301 redirects from old Hostinger-Horizons URLs to the new slugs (CLAUDE.md §7). GitHub Pages has no server-side redirects, so Astro renders a static redirect page per exact entry (list each path once, without the trailing slash). Wildcard entries (`from` ending in /*) cannot be static pages: they are handled by dist/404.html, which GitHub Pages serves for every unknown path and which sends the visitor to `to` (client-side). Real 301s and www→apex happen at DNS switch (phase 4). Decision 9 Oct 2026: old /branches/<uuid> pages have no mapping → everything under /branches/ goes to the home page; the 404 page also lists both branches.
www_to_apex: 301 at Hostinger DNS / GitHub Pages custom domain — not part of the static build
